reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and the lab report plus the empty-box refund make one box a low-risk try. I would only do it at the $24.99 launch price, not $29.99.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli and those last longer. I can probably get plain magnesium glycinate for less, so I am paying extra for the sachets.
would_change_my_mind: If the launch price were not there and it was full $29.99 with no coupon, I would skip it and buy a cheaper bottle.
